description: One sprint later: gift wrap ships (story DEMO-121 changes, with a bug in the new fee), an unrelated regression appears in listed prices, and the sprint-1 tax rounding bug is fixed. Two sprint-1 bugs are still open.

baseline.note: The state for run 1. Every switch not listed is off; stories are at version 1.

changes.title: Cart and order totals are always correct
changes.criteria:
A line total is the price times the quantity.
The subtotal is the sum of the line totals.
A discount never exceeds the subtotal.
Tax is 8% of (subtotal - discount), rounded to the nearest cent.
The total is subtotal - discount + shipping + tax.
Gift wrap costs $4.99 once per order; when chosen, the order total includes it.

changes.why: The new feature ships with a fee bug
A regression in an area no story touched

newSurface: the Gift wrap option at checkout
knownOracleGaps: total-mismatch on orders with gift wrap: the built-in total oracle does not know the fee; the changed story must correct the expectation instead of a false positive being reported
